comparison.objective: Arrange a board and scrap backing for centered drill-through, not commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Board/backer transport, stacking, and drill-axis alignment versus small-tool insertion, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Board centered and backed beneath the exit; body only names the directory and no spec versions or drilling/tolerance rubric are available. Candidate requires two safe dynamic cycles.
comparison.reason: Workpiece fixturing for drilling does not test damping calibration or setting retention.
